name: Demon Fall Ridge
summary: Demons hold Demon Fall Ridge in southeastern Ashenvale, above the place where Mannoroth fell. Fel magic still stains the heights, and the Burning Legion has claimed a night elf barrow den.

sections.title: A Perch Over Corruption
sections.body: West of Demon Fall Canyon, Demon Fall Ridge looks down on the place where Grommash Hellscream fought the pit lord Mannoroth. Its cliffs still bear the fel scars of the Third War. The demons who survived use the heights as a staging ground. Lesser demons patrol the rocky slopes, defile the woodland, and threaten travelers along Ashenvale’s southern border.

sections.title: The Desecrated Barrow
sections.body: A night elf barrow den lies abandoned in the ridge’s side. Dark sorcery now fills the passages where druids once slept. Fel fiends prowl its halls, and deep within, Diathorus the Seeker rules the conclave. The cunning dreadlord directs the demons who remain across the forest.

faq.answer: Demon Fall Ridge rises in southeastern Ashenvale, west of Demon Fall Canyon and near the Barrens border.

faq.q: Why are there demons on this ridge?
faq.answer: The ridge overlooks the place where Mannoroth died in the Third War. Demons who survived the Legion’s defeat scattered into the heights and entrenched themselves on the ridge and in an abandoned barrow den.
Diathorus the Seeker commands the conclave from the deepest reaches of the barrow den. He is a powerful nathrezim dreadlord.

faq.q: What is the structure carved into the ridge?
faq.answer: The structure is an ancient night elf barrow den, once a druid sanctuary for entering the Emerald Dream. It was abandoned, then overrun and desecrated by the Burning Legion.

angles.text: As a druid, you find demons occupying a barrow den once sacred to the Emerald Dream. Their presence affronts the Cenarion Circle.
As a warlock, you find an active dreadlord leading the fel forces. His command reveals how the Legion’s remnants are organized in Kalimdor.
